newsitem.title: ITALY: Pope likely to visit Sarajevo April 13 - diplomat.
newsitem.headline: Pope likely to visit Sarajevo April 13 - diplomat.

text.p: Pope John Paul will most likely make his long-awaited trip to Sarajevo on April 13, a diplomat said on Friday.

"I have had talks with Vatican and Italian foreign ministers. We have no official date, but it is very likely that a Papal visit will be set for April 13," said Michael Steiner, deputy to the major powers' envoy to Bosnia, Carl Bildt.
Steiner told a news conference he met Archbishop Jean Louis Tauran, the Vatican's "foreign minister," and gave him "all the assurances for the Pope's safety."
The 76-year-old Polish Pontiff had to cancel a day trip to the Bosnian capital in September 1994 -- while the war was still raging -- because of security reasons
Steiner said he had given Vatican officials a letter for the Pope from Bosnian President Alija Izetbegovic regarding the trip.
The Vatican has said a Papal visit to Sarajevo is being planned but has not announced the date.
